answer: SELECT c."CLSTR_PIN" AS cluster_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.acct_bridge) AS member_count, AVG((0.4 * n."ConnQual" + 0.3 * c."NetInfl" + 0.3 * n."IntDiv")) AS avg_nic, MAX(c."CoordScore") AS max_coordination_score, CASE WHEN MAX(c."CoordScore") > 0.8 AND AVG((0.4 * n."ConnQual" + 0.3 * c."NetInfl" + 0.3 * n."IntDiv")) > 0.7 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS coordinated_influence_operation FROM cluster_analysis c LEFT JOIN account_clusters ac ON ac.clu_ref = c."CLSTR_PIN" LEFT JOIN network_metrics n ON n.acct_node = ac.acct_bridge WHERE c."CluRole" = 'SocialGroup' GROUP BY c."CLSTR_PIN" ORDER BY max_coordination_score DESC NULLS LAST, c."CLSTR_PIN"
note: Coordinated Influence Operation needs NSI/CAE/Content Manipulation Ring inputs not in the DB; approximated as max coordination score > 0.8 and avg NIC > 0.7. NIC uses the cluster's NetInfl as network influence score.

answer: SELECT a.acct_ref, ROUND(MAX((s.session_telemetry->'session_stats'->>'session_count')::numeric) / a."AGE_D", 3) AS aaf FROM accounts a JOIN security_sessions s ON s.acct_gate = a.acct_ref WHERE a."AGE_D" IS NOT NULL AND a."AGE_D" > 0 AND s.session_telemetry->'session_stats'->>'session_count' IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.acct_ref, a."AGE_D" ORDER BY MAX((s.session_telemetry->'session_stats'->>'session_count')::numeric) / a."AGE_D" DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT r.acct_risk AS acct_ref, ROUND((0.4 * (r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'risk_value')::numeric + 0.3 * (1 - (r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'trust_score')::numeric) + 0.3 * (r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'impact_score')::numeric), 3) AS srs FROM risk_and_moderation r WHERE r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'risk_value' IS NOT NULL AND r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'trust_score' IS NOT NULL AND r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'impact_score' IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (0.4 * (r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'risk_value')::numeric + 0.3 * (1 - (r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'trust_score')::numeric) + 0.3 * (r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'impact_score')::numeric) DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT b.acct_beh AS acct_ref, ROUND((0.4 * (b.behavioral_anomaly_scores->'automation_spam'->>'bot_likelihood')::numeric + 0.3 * (b.behavioral_anomaly_scores->'automation_spam'->>'automated_behavior')::numeric + 0.3 * (1 - i."ConvNat"::numeric)), 3) AS bbi FROM behavioral_scores b JOIN interaction_metrics i ON i.acct_dm = b.acct_beh WHERE (0.4 * (b.behavioral_anomaly_scores->'automation_spam'->>'bot_likelihood')::numeric + 0.3 * (b.behavioral_anomaly_scores->'automation_spam'->>'automated_behavior')::numeric + 0.3 * (1 - i."ConvNat"::numeric)) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (0.4 * (b.behavioral_anomaly_scores->'automation_spam'->>'bot_likelihood')::numeric + 0.3 * (b.behavioral_anomaly_scores->'automation_spam'->>'automated_behavior')::numeric + 0.3 * (1 - i."ConvNat"::numeric)) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT n.acct_node AS acct_ref, ROUND(SQRT(POWER(n."FollGrow"::numeric, 2) + POWER(n."FingGrow"::numeric, 2)), 3) AS ngv FROM network_metrics n ORDER BY SQRT(POWER(n."FollGrow"::numeric, 2) + POWER(n."FingGrow"::numeric, 2)) DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT s.acct_gate AS acct_ref, (s.session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'country_count')::int AS login_country_count FROM security_sessions s WHERE (0.4 * REPLACE(s.session_telemetry->>'vpn_usage_pct','%','')::numeric + 0.3 * (s.session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'proxy_hits')::numeric / 10 + 0.3 * (s.session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'country_count')::numeric / 20) > 0.8 AND (s.session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'country_count')::int >= 3 ORDER BY login_country_count DESC, s.acct_gate
note: VPN ratio taken from vpn_usage_pct with the '%' stripped (values already lie in 0-1).

answer: SELECT s.acct_gate AS acct_ref, ROUND((0.4 * REPLACE(s.session_telemetry->>'vpn_usage_pct','%','')::numeric + 0.3 * (s.session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'proxy_hits')::numeric / 10 + 0.3 * (s.session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'country_count')::numeric / 20), 3) AS tei FROM security_sessions s ORDER BY (0.4 * REPLACE(s.session_telemetry->>'vpn_usage_pct','%','')::numeric + 0.3 * (s.session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'proxy_hits')::numeric / 10 + 0.3 * (s.session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'country_count')::numeric / 20) DESC NULLS LAST
note: VPN ratio taken from vpn_usage_pct with the '%' stripped (values already lie in 0-1).

answer: SELECT s.acct_gate AS acct_ref, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY (0.4 * REPLACE(s.session_telemetry->>'vpn_usage_pct','%','')::numeric + 0.3 * (s.session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'proxy_hits')::numeric / 10 + 0.3 * (s.session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'country_count')::numeric / 20)) AS tei_quartile FROM security_sessions s WHERE (0.4 * REPLACE(s.session_telemetry->>'vpn_usage_pct','%','')::numeric + 0.3 * (s.session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'proxy_hits')::numeric / 10 + 0.3 * (s.session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'country_count')::numeric / 20) IS NOT NULL
note: VPN ratio taken from vpn_usage_pct with the '%' stripped (values already lie in 0-1).

answer: WITH q AS (SELECT s.acct_gate, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY (0.4 * REPLACE(s.session_telemetry->>'vpn_usage_pct','%','')::numeric + 0.3 * (s.session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'proxy_hits')::numeric / 10 + 0.3 * (s.session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'country_count')::numeric / 20)) AS quartile FROM security_sessions s WHERE (0.4 * REPLACE(s.session_telemetry->>'vpn_usage_pct','%','')::numeric + 0.3 * (s.session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'proxy_hits')::numeric / 10 + 0.3 * (s.session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'country_count')::numeric / 20) IS NOT NULL) SELECT CASE quartile WHEN 1 THEN 'Low Risk' WHEN 2 THEN 'Moderate Risk' WHEN 3 THEN 'High Risk' ELSE 'Very High Risk' END AS tei_risk_category, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM q GROUP BY quartile ORDER BY quartile
note: VPN ratio taken from vpn_usage_pct with the '%' stripped (values already lie in 0-1).

answer: SELECT r.acct_risk AS acct_ref, ROUND((0.4 * (r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'risk_value')::numeric + 0.3 * (1 - (r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'trust_score')::numeric) + 0.3 * (r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'impact_score')::numeric), 3) AS srs, r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'threat_level' AS severity FROM risk_and_moderation r WHERE (0.4 * (r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'risk_value')::numeric + 0.3 * (1 - (r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'trust_score')::numeric) + 0.3 * (r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'impact_score')::numeric) > 0.7 AND r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'threat_level' = 'Critical' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM monitoring m WHERE m.acct_mon = r.acct_risk AND m."InvestState" = 'Active') ORDER BY (0.4 * (r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'risk_value')::numeric + 0.3 * (1 - (r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'trust_score')::numeric) + 0.3 * (r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'impact_score')::numeric) DESC
